mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary CD experiments support alpha-helical structure in TFE and random-coil profiles in water; this is structural context, not by itself a killing mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote secondary-structure context alone to direct antibacterial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary bactericidal, catalase-release, and TEM evidence supports rapid killing with bacterial envelope disruption/content release after peptide treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Kn2-7 against S. aureus AB94004 and E. coli AB94012
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure panels are qualitative/curve evidence; exact graph-only point values were not inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary BLI and competition MIC evidence supports Kn2-7 binding to LTA and LPS, with BmKn2 binding LTA but not LPS under the reported BLI assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Kn2-7 binding to bacterial cell-wall components
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is bounded to the reported LTA/LPS binding and envelope-disruption assays; no unreported structural binding constants are invented.
